## Deepanshu Goel

:::

::: {.column width="50%" style="text-align: left;"}

Welcome to my website! I’m Deepanshu Goel, a Master of Public Health (MPH) Epidemiology graduate from Emory University Rollins School of Public Health with a growing focus on data analytics in public health as evident by my certificate in Data Science. I use tools like R and Python to explore health data, uncover insights, and support data-driven decisions that improve population health. I am a physician by background.
